name: ZxZ
author: Ścisław Dercz
description: An action platformer set in a purple maze of pipes and platforms crawling with creatures, with an energy bar at the bottom. A WASM-4 game jam entry.

descriptions.en: An action platformer set in a purple maze of pipes and platforms crawling with creatures, with an energy bar at the bottom. A WASM-4 game jam entry.
descriptions.it: Un platform d'azione ambientato in un labirinto viola di tubi e piattaforme pieno di creature, con una barra di energia in basso. Creato per la jam di WASM-4.
